details:
VrChat public group sincerely needs a rework, Today I was harassed yet again, not by simple users but by the very own moderation of a public group. Not only was I harassed but I was officially banned from a group. while I have been banned from multiple groups for my personal view on politics or my religion or simply in all honesty, being out of pockets, today I was kicked without warning and no valuable reasons. countless times have I been forcefully muted while holding a conversation with my friends just because someone did not agree with me or because I was not speaking English with my foreign friends, sometimes even kicked me because of my origins. All of those thing did not happen in a private world or in an instances where everybody was agreeing that I should be kicked out because "why not", no, these things were all done by group owners or their moderation. I am in all honesty tired of the constant injustice you can encounter in these "public group". I can absolutely understand a PRIVATE group of anglophones wanting to be with other anglophones but a public group? Not at all. Here is the definition of public : 

"Public" refers to people in general, the community, or things accessible/related to everyone rather than specific individuals. It denotes openness to observation, government-run services, or shared knowledge. Common synonyms include common, open, unrestricted, social, popular, and known.

Now we can observe in our everyday lives that certain public services or places are sometimes reserved to certain groups of people here is a few good examples : Bars for adults, seniors-Only Housing & Facilities, Youth Shelters & Spaces or women only spaces). I don't remember a function in VrChat where you can prevent access to people because of their Identity, origins or general interest, I do remember a function that allows player to get their age verified by VrChat or useful enough groups that are preventing the access for people that are under 18 years old I am all for that but please explain to me why I am still getting asked "age and date of birth" at the entrance of a non age gated instance and getting kicked because "you did not answer fast enough pal" when I am fixing my microphone to go against my will and deliver personal information to a stranger I have never met before. 

I have seen all sorts of groups on VrChat, groups for musicians, groups for car lovers, group for general gathering and friend meeting, group for Fortnite player and many great groups, on the darker side of thing groups for "verified crazy b*tches", "verified brat tamers", groups for white people only or black people only, you get the absurdity. I am well aware that it would be practically impossible for VrChat to ban all groups that are going against terms of services, but I am tired of seeing people getting kicked out of worlds for being Ukrainian or simply because they are not the same color as the group owner. This is ridiculous, what is this 1960s united states what happen to no more segregation, earlier this year I joined an instance and the first thing I was asked is " Age and Race?" stayed acting afk a couple minutes for observation and the people who were not the "right" ethnicity (as they said) were getting kicked and being called all sort of racial slurs at the same time.

I don't propose perfection I propose improvement, why give all the power to people who are unable to use them properly and respectfully when we are able to start a vote kick (like in a regular public instance) and collectively agree that someone is deserving of a ticket back to their home world. I am conscious that vote kicks don't always work and that it isn't perfect, in my opinions their isn't a lot of perfection in this world, and when a vote kick does work, it is beautiful to see. when a vote kick is successful, it is usually just and agreed upon the majority of the instance, not agreed by one person who had a bad day but ten people who collectively agreed that the person being kicked out is acting out of pocket. 

 People are abusing of features and no one is doing anything about it. Usually reporting someone or a group is very effective but reporting someone for abusing of their moderation power isn't really a thing or at least i haven't heard of it being a thing ( correct me if wrong please). 

In 2022 VrChat stated using an anti-cheat launcher to prevent people from using modified clients, because it was getting out of control.

Things are clearly out of control in the department of group moderators and owners, and this time there isn't any "anti-moderation-abuse" program to save the situation. I don't see VrChat staff going around banning people for not liking AC/DC, why are group moderators able to?

I hope with all my heart that someone will read this, and I hope that someone will at least think about doing something about this chaos...

Please excuse any grammatical errors made on my part.

Thank you,

Best regards, 

APIM agent 1.
title: Public Groups instances need a serious rework !!!!
